div.div: Complete EPS MVP General Use Case Diagram: all 22 unique use cases (U1-U8, B1-B4, S1-S2, A1-A5, P1-P3) and 7 external actors in one system boundary. Buyer and Seller are transaction-scoped roles; Admin is pre-provisioned; Merchant uses separate client authentication (B1.API / U4.API). B3 includes P1 (funding confirmation) and B4 includes P2 (release via Partner Bank mock); U8 (accepted refund proposal) and A1 (Admin dispute resolution) conditionally invoke P2 / P3.

text.tspan: Complete EPS MVP General Use Case Diagram: all 22 unique use cases (U1-U8, B1-B4, S1-S2, A1-A5, P1-P3) and 7 external actors in one system boundary. Buyer and Seller are transaction-scoped roles;
Admin is pre-provisioned; Merchant uses separate client authentication (B1.API / U4.API). B3 includes P1 (funding confirmation) and B4 includes P2 (release via Partner Bank mock); U8 (accepted refund
proposal) and A1 (Admin dispute resolution) conditionally invoke P2 / P3.
